limits: Static actual-app saved-state replay only; not microphone, iPhone binary, interactive editing, model rollout or live progressive rendering.
All 71 images personally inspected through nine contact sheets; 27 originals opened where desktop math, labels or failure details needed closer inspection.
Queries/previews often leave saved work unchanged; screenshot review cannot establish their spoken or text answer correctness.
Automated grades are retained unchanged; visual equivalence is noted separately from strict saved-state contract failures.
Viewport scale/aspect and mobile y tick alignment can confuse coordinate reading; curve shape was compared with saved expressions and reference state.

findings.note: Wrong name/edit, viewport, domain/mode, translation, or diagram outcome visible; see per-image observations.
Visual math/flow appears equivalent despite strict representation/history grading failure; do not silently change reported grades.

Mobile y-axis tick text sits noticeably below associated gridlines; dense two-unit tick spacing can make correct plotted values appear one tick higher. Polar circle/arc is visually stretched by unequal plot scales. Existing renderer behavior, not evidence of model math error.
Desktop original graph editor appears to show only 1 while history and curve represent x^2+1. Needs separate renderer/capture diagnosis; no claim of cause.
